name: Native-history regional low-rank capture and optimization gate
status: Prospective engineering/training-only follow-up after failed Run134 accuracy screen
sampling_rule: Reuse the exact four author-sampled clips from Run132. No selection by validation outcome, frame quality or failure severity.
capture: Run the pinned unmodified SAM2 video predictor from the full video's first GT-positive prompt through the block. No later GT prompts. Check every processed native prediction against archived Run118 hashes. Preserve original manifest positions, full video num_frames, native spatial memories, pointers and positions. Regions use each stored prediction. Ground truth supplies target supervision only.
replay_gate: Require bit-equal native low-resolution predictions, object scores for every target and all intermediate autoregressive memory writes with full and compact history. Require equal full/compact losses, untouched source banks, identical selected spatial inputs and all pointer inputs. Zero regional/global adapters must reproduce native targets. Check actual four-layer schedules and native key counts before optimization.
method: Same 6144-parameter author-LoRA regional/global arms, loss and optimizer as Run132/134. Only capture context changes. No inference threshold, confidence gate, frame-quality selection, region-definition change or hyperparameter sweep.
measurements: Save capture provenance, full video lengths, pointer normalization denominators, read frame IDs/key counts, prefix replay receipts, initial/final fixed training losses and all 20 updates. Verify finite gradients/weights, unchanged backbone/source hashes and paired schedules. CPU FP32 with native BF16 memory storage; outputs and tracking on Drive only.
decision: Stop on integrity failure; diagnose without bypassing the check. A decrease in mean fixed training loss shows optimization responsiveness only. No held-out accuracy or full CV in this gate. Do not reuse these diagnostic weights in later CV or choose parameters from its results.

prior_work.adaptation: Native video-history capture and compact training-block replay are project integration. This is not a reproduction of the paper's eight/sixteen-frame interactive training recipe.

scope: Single-object PolypGen engineering and training-only diagnostic on previously used training clips; not clinical validation, patient-independent evidence or an external benchmark. Adapter multi-object support is unchanged.
